**Observation Log:**

- [TEMPORAL] Session Date: 2023/05/29 (Mon) 18:09
- [EVENT] User is looking to plan back-to-school shopping and is seeking tips on how to save money.
- [EVENT] User made a big purchase at Target last week and earned 500 points on their Target RedCard.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant congratulated the user on earning 500 points on their Target RedCard.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant provided tips to save money on back-to-school shopping, including:
  1. Make a list and stick to it.
  2. Set a budget.
  3. Shop during tax-free weekends.
  4. Look for sales and discounts.
  5. Use cashback apps.
  6. Buy in bulk.
  7. Shop secondhand.
  8. Use coupons and promo codes.
  9. Consider alternative brands.
  10. Shop during off-peak seasons.
  11. Use price comparison tools.
  12. Take advantage of price matching.
- [USER] User plans to make a list and stick to it and will look out for sales and discounts at Target.
- [EVENT] User is interested in cashback apps for back-to-school shopping.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant recommended the following cashback apps:
  1. Ibotta
  2. Fetch Rewards
  3. Rakuten (formerly known as Ebates)
  4. RetailMeNot
  5. Checkout 51
  6. Dosh
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant provided tips on how to use cashback apps effectively, including downloading the apps, browsing for offers, activating offers before purchases, and taking photos of receipts.
- [EVENT] User has heard of Rakuten and RetailMeNot but not the other cashback apps.
- [EVENT] User is using the loyalty program at The Daily Grind coffee shop and redeemed 100 points for a free latte last Friday.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant mentioned that the previously recommended apps are more focused on larger retailers and may not track points for small businesses like The Daily Grind.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant suggested using The Daily Grind's mobile app, digital loyalty card apps, or a spreadsheet to track points and rewards.
- [EVENT] User is considering canceling their loyalty membership at Barnes & Noble due to not reading as much lately.
- [EVENT] User received an email from Barnes & Noble offering a $10 reward if they spend $50 within the next two weeks.
- [USER] User decided to keep the Barnes & Noble membership to use the $10 reward for a new book.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant discussed the pros and cons of keeping the Barnes & Noble membership and
